rows.note: Use this for the general state or process of being distracted; it is the all-purpose noun phrase for this sense.

example.english: There was constant distraction during the meeting, so productivity was naturally low.
example.traditional: 開會嗰陣成日有分心嘅情況，效率自然低。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 jau5 fan1 sam1 ge3 cing4 fong3 haau6 leot6 zi6 jin4 dai1

rows.note: Use this for an object, activity, or other thing that pulls someone's attention away.

example.english: My phone is such a distraction—I can't stop checking it when I'm studying.
example.traditional: 部電話真係分心嘢，溫書溫吓就忍唔住睇。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 fan1 sam1 je5 wan1 syu1 wan1 haa5 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 tai2
